text:
This command-line tool converts Markdown to PDF, and it does it quickly. You can use it for reports, documentation, or anything else you want to share as a PDF.

It's written in Go and ships as one self-contained 8 MB binary. There's no runtime to install and no dependency chain to manage, so you don't need Python, Node, or LaTeX. Download it, put it on your PATH, and start converting.

A 100-page document renders in 1.2 seconds, and headings, code blocks, and tables come out clean.

It's free and open source under the MIT license, so you can use, modify, and share it however you like.
